summary: Jest suite runs cleanly (56 suites/513 tests) with strong coverage and extensive @supports traceability, with a single zero-coverage maintenance parser and a handful of low-branch helpers remaining.
reasoning: `npm test` and `npm test -- --coverage` both pass (56/56 suites, 513 tests), indicating stable execution across rules, utils, maintenance, config, perf, and CLI integration flows.
Coverage is high overall (statements/lines ~95.6%, functions 98.08%, branches 86.58%) and configured thresholds are met.
Tests are behavior-focused with RuleTester-based cases, explicit error/suggestion assertions, and CLI integration coverage using `spawnSync`.
Traceability annotations are pervasive (234 @supports across test files), supporting requirement/story mapping.
Coverage gaps remain in `src/maintenance/storyParser.ts` (0%) and several low-branch helper modules, limiting confidence in edge branches.

improvement_path.item: Add targeted tests for `src/maintenance/storyParser.ts` to cover parsing behaviors, error handling, and edge cases.
improvement_path.rationale: Eliminates the only 0% coverage file and raises confidence in maintenance tooling.

improvement_path.item: Increase branch coverage for low-branch helpers (`src/index.ts`, `src/rules/require-traceability.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/prefer-implements-inline.ts`, `src/rules/helpers/require-test-traceability-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/function-annotation-helpers.ts`, `src/utils/branch-annotation-switch-helpers.ts`).
improvement_path.rationale: Targets known weak branches without large test overhead.

improvement_path.item: Add package.json scripts to run unit vs integration tests separately (e.g., `test:unit`, `test:integration`) using Jest `--testPathPattern`.
improvement_path.rationale: Improves focus and speed for targeted runs and clearer test segmentation.

rationale: Package exports compiled plugin entrypoints (`main`/`types` -> `lib/src`), indicating a distributable library.
Peer dependency on `eslint` and tests focused on ESLint rules/configs align with a plugin library.
A maintenance CLI exists via `bin`, but the primary deliverable is the ESLint plugin itself.
